guardReview.readerLimitCaveat: The 34 MB aggregate response-reader allowance limits consumed bytes, not server wire egress or billing. The generic 16 MiB UDF result limit is not asserted for administrative deployment endpoints.

sourceProof.classification: Deployment Analyze and direct administrative JSON responses are outside the visible UDF-execution billing path and published user-action/file-egress categories. This is a source-backed interpretation of the published contract, not a cryptographic assertion of the hosted binary.

references.finding: Usage CallType enumerates actions, HTTP actions, queries, mutations and system work; no deployment Analyze call type.
The source states that accumulated function usage is rolled into track_call at UDF completion and billing is limited to usage reaching the UDF execution log.
Module analysis partitions Node and isolate modules. Empty Node groups return without invocation. Nonempty groups call NodeActions.analyze; this path has no function-execution billing/logging call.

AnalyzeResponse contains modules or analysis errors, without the execution-time, memory and egress usage fields carried by ExecuteResponse. Analysis imports modules and inspects registrations rather than invoking their registered action bodies.
A physical start_push evaluates its contents once, including one root analysis; component analysis follows the bounded supplied definition list.
Schema prediction evaluates schema bundles without runtime-module analysis or upload; its transaction is dropped uncommitted.
Internal Node analyzer invocation has a retry loop, so physical CLI request count alone must not be called the analyzer count.

Dynamic analysis runtime memory defaults to 4096 MB and analyzer retries default to three, giving four attempts per nonempty Node group. These are configurable implementation defaults, not a hosted billing ceiling.

Visible administrative handlers call Application deployment methods and return JSON directly, without a UDF function execution or file-download metering wrapper. Private hosted routing may add implementation outside this public file.
Application administrative OCC helper delegates to the database and discards returned transaction statistics, without a UsageCounter tracking call in this helper.

Published function-call categories are query, mutation, action, HTTP action and file storage. Published data-egress scope is file downloads, outgoing fetch and log-stream egress, rather than arbitrary admin JSON responses.

Published Starter rates used for the conservative allowances are database I/O/storage $0.22/GB, function calls $2.20/million, file data egress $0.132/GB and a 1.3 non-US multiplier. UDF transaction/return limits are scoped to functions, not all admin endpoints.

rootPreparedMetadataObservation.observedBy: core_audit using the installed CLI offline bundler; not a hosted observation

arithmetic.overlapAllowance: 2 requests * 0.032 GB * 3 allowances (read, write, month storage) * $0.22/GB * 1.3; intentionally overcounts schema-only evaluation and overlaps the separate code-storage hold
arithmetic.pureQueries: 4 * (16 MiB database read * $0.22/GB + 16 MiB conservative return-egress allowance * $0.132/GB + $2.20/million calls) * 1.3
arithmetic.uncertainty: Unreleased remainder of the $0.30 envelope, not a measured or invented provider price

conditionsAndLimits: Root must make the reservation before dispatch and use the exact reviewed guard hashes, installed CLI, fixed receipt path and existing deployment target; deliberate replacement receipt/config filenames are not a new budget grant
Fresh live prediction must satisfy the mandatory unchanged schema/index gate; source agreement or old local fixtures do not replace it
No action invocation, provider processing, new source acquisition, inference, job enqueue, funding fallback, new deployment provisioning, flag change, new cron or schema migration is included
The exact two-query postcheck guard is independently reviewed in this receipt; four query RPCs remain financially held as an overcount, and the two processes must run sequentially
The exact hosted Convex binary, private Conductor routing/instrumentation and all invoice treatment cannot be cryptographically established from public source
No explicit documentation sentence promises every administrative response is free; classification follows the published meter definitions and visible execution paths, with uncertainty retained
Response reader cancellation is not a wire-egress cap, and admin requests do not inherit generic UDF 16 MiB limits
Storage allowance uses a one-month accounting horizon; this does not fund indefinite future retention or service operation
Independent concurrent traffic and future scheduled workloads are outside the CLI guard; root's existing controls, retained holds and whole-task ledger remain authoritative
Transport-complete responses alone never release the reserved envelope; ambiguous dispatch remains fully held until authoritative reconciliation
No hosted Convex application call, production mutation, browser action, reservation or spend was performed by this review
